ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND OPPORTUNITY
  COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Dr. Suely Saro, Chair
Cindy Allen, Vice Chair
Mary Zendejas, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online public comments and email
  comments to cityclerk@longbeach.gov

  Please view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone via:
  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54864  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development and
  Opportunity Committee meeting of Tuesday, December 16, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54865  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Business Outreach and
  Education including Business Walks, Know Your Rights, and Economic Impacts.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54866  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Long Beach Economic
  Partnership.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Economic Development and Opportunity Committee on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
